title: Steepleaf
lead: A calm tea companion — what to brew today, how to steep it well, and how today’s cup compares to yesterday’s.
mission: Help people brew with attention using a private collection, guided sessions, practical tea literacy, and an educational knowledge graph.
principles: Recommendations explain why and stay optional
Brew notes stay private on this device
No fabricated tasting journals or marketplace pressure

modules.title: Today's Tea briefing
modules.description: Personalized guidance from your shelf and sessions — never invented cups.

modules.title: Today's Brew workflow
modules.description: Temperature, leaf, timer, infusions, and notes with minimal taps.

modules.title: My Collection
modules.description: Type, origin, harvest, vendor, storage, quantity, favorites, search and filters.

modules.title: Brewing sessions & journal
modules.description: History with parameters, mood, rating, and comparison to prior brews.

modules.title: Discover & Learning
modules.description: Style map and practical literacy — not a shopfront.

modules.title: Knowledge graph
modules.description: Educational explore/entity discovery layer with labeled sample data.

dataModel: Teas and brew sessions stay in localStorage on this device. The knowledge graph uses labeled educational sample data separate from your private journal.
privacyPhilosophy: Brew notes stay private. There is no marketplace and no public tasting board.
futureDirection: Deeper persona preferences, optional Knowledge cross-links, and refined timer UX — still without social graphs.
